subject: Lisan Prime audio and full lyrics received; missing-source concern resolved, timing still unset
body:
Lisan two-track update, correlation LISAN-TWO-TRACK-20261012-234228Z: Ziggy directly supplied Meta Mirror_0 (Remastered).mp3 and the full lyric text and designated both Prime. This resolves the previously reported missing-master/full-lyric-source concern. The unchanged canonical MP3 is 6,438,669 bytes; the recorded complete technical decode measures 249.720 seconds at 48 kHz stereo. No listening or lyric/audio alignment is claimed.

The full Meta_Mirror.txt contains 134 lines matching Claude's earlier first-set draft when only line endings and trailing whitespace are ignored; this comparison was independently checked. MM_0 remains a separate later cut. OFFICIAL_MASTER_INTAKE.json and CFA_COORDINATION_STATUS.json now record Prime receipt. All 50 scene timings remain null; timedLyricMap is null. The standalone Lisan/Jet story remains a separate track.

Canonical intake, lyrics and audio references with verified hashes are attached. No provider upload, generation or new writing assignment occurred in this update. Please surface the resolved intake status to Ziggy when active. Native direct relay remains broken; this is posted locally only, with delivery, reading and wakeup unconfirmed.
